title: Europe’s total solar eclipse: the best place to see it and how to view it safely

paragraphs.en: On Wednesday evening, millions of Europeans will experience a celestial treat: a solar eclipse. A wide band of north and central Spain, plus a sliver of Portugal and parts of Greenland and Iceland will experience a rare total eclipse. The light of the setting sun will be virtually blocked out across much of western Europe, including the UK, France, Belgium, Switzerland and northern Italy.
paragraphs.zh: 周三傍晚，数百万欧洲人将体验一场天文盛宴：日食。西班牙北部和中部的广阔地带，加上葡萄牙的一小片区域以及格陵兰和冰岛的部分地区，将经历罕见的日全食。在西欧大部分地区——包括英国、法国、比利时、瑞士和意大利北部——落日的光芒几乎将被完全遮蔽。

paragraphs.en: A solar eclipse occurs when the moon passes directly between the Earth and the sun, resulting in the moon casting a shadow on the Earth.
paragraphs.zh: 当月球直接从地球与太阳之间穿过，致使月球在地球上投下阴影时，就会发生日食。

paragraphs.en: Viewers see a total solar eclipse when the sun’s light is fully blocked by the moon – meaning they are in the umbra of the moon’s shadow – and a partial solar eclipse when only part of the light is blocked, meaning they are in the penumbra of the moon’s shadow.
paragraphs.zh: 当太阳的光芒被月球完全遮挡（即观测者位于月球本影之中）时，观测者看到的是日全食；当只有部分光芒被遮挡（即观测者位于月球半影之中）时，看到的是日偏食。

paragraphs.en: “The moon and sun have to line up precisely for the moon to fully cover the sun and for you to see a total eclipse,” said Dr Megan Argo, a reader in astrophysics at the University of Lancashire and the vice-president of the Society for Popular Astronomy. “Because the orbit of the moon is slightly tilted, it doesn’t appear to cross the disc of the sun from our perspective each time it orbits the Earth.”
paragraphs.zh: “要让月球完全遮住太阳、让您看到日全食，月球和太阳必须精确地排成一线。”兰开夏大学天体物理学高级讲师、大众天文学会副会长梅根·阿尔戈博士说，“由于月球的轨道略有倾斜，从我们的视角看，它并非每次绕地球运行时都会跨越太阳圆面。”

paragraphs.en: Whether viewers see a total or partial eclipse – or no eclipse at all – depends upon their location on the Earth’s surface. “You have to be right in the middle of the shadow to see a total eclipse, and that is quite a narrow track on the Earth’s surface,” said Argo.
paragraphs.zh: 观测者看到的是日全食、日偏食还是根本看不到日食，取决于他们在地球表面的位置。“您必须正好处于阴影的正中央才能看到日全食，而那是地球表面上一条相当狭窄的轨迹。”阿尔戈说。

paragraphs.en: This total eclipse will be the first in mainland Europe in two decades. The last event of this kind visible from the UK occurred in 1999, when parts of Devon and Cornwall were in the path of totality. The next total solar eclipse visible in the UK is not due to occur until 2090.
paragraphs.zh: 这次日全食将是欧洲大陆二十年来的首次。上一次从英国可见的此类事件发生在1999年，当时德文郡和康沃尔郡的部分地区位于全食路径之上。下一次在英国可见的日全食要到2090年才会出现。

paragraphs.en: Related: Spanish mountain village braces for astrotourists lured by total solar eclipse
paragraphs.zh: 相关阅读：西班牙山村因日全食吸引天文游客而严阵以待

paragraphs.en: While the country will only experience a partial solar eclipse on Wednesday, experts are enthusiastic, noting the next comparable event visible in the UK will be in 2081. “This is the best [solar] eclipse that we’ve had in the UK since 1999. There have been a few other partial eclipses, but not one that’s this deep, which has this percentage of the sun eclipsed by the moon,” said Argo.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管英国周三只能看到日偏食，专家们仍热情高涨，并指出英国下一次可见的类似事件将在2081年到来。“这是自1999年以来我们在英国看到的最好的（日）食。此前也有一些其他的偏食，但没有一次有这么深，没有被月球遮蔽这么高百分比的太阳。”阿尔戈说。
